# SKWorld

> Sovereign AI infrastructure. An owned stack from silicon to soul: identity and
> post-quantum security, infrastructure, memory, communications, agents, and
> soul. 36 open projects across 7 layers, all running on hardware you control.

The thesis: every layer of an AI stack should be owned rather than rented. Your
data, your keys, your hardware. Adopting one piece never obliges you to adopt
the whole, and leaving is always possible.

## Three pillars

1. First principles. The default stack was not accepted. Every layer was
   questioned and rebuilt: open, swappable, yours.
2. The full vertical. No rented middle, no black-box bottom. One cohesive stack
   rather than a bag of services you depend on.
3. Data sovereignty. Your data is yours cryptographically and physically. It
   never leaves your control.

## The stack, ordered silicon to soul

01 Identity and Security
   capauth.skworld.io    CapAuth, sovereign identity protocol, auth without OAuth
   sksecurity.skworld.io SKSecurity, security built for AI agents
   skpqc.skworld.io      sk_pqc, hybrid post-quantum crypto, X25519 + ML-KEM-768
   skvault.skworld.io    SKVault, the sovereign secrets vault
